# Logo

The mark is **a blank sheet on the platform beneath it**: a white sheet (the customer's surface) resting on a blue platform (Whity), offset up and to the right. The wordmark is "Whity" in Readex Pro 600, capital W, always in Latin letters.

![The mark on its 12-module grid: side 8, offset 3, radius 2, edge 1](data:image/png;base64,)

## The mark

Everything is measured in one module, **m**: the width of the blue edge (2px when the mark is 24px, the same as the Tabler icon stroke).

| | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Planes | Both 8 m square |
| Offset | The sheet sits 3 m up and 3 m right of the platform (0.375 of the side) |
| Radius | 2 m outside, 1 m inside, concentric circular arcs, so the edge is exactly 1 m at every angle |
| Canvas | 12 m square, 0.5 m padding, live area 11 m |

Three rules hold the whole identity together:

- **Every corner is ¼ of what it ends**: the planes (2 m on 8 m), the dot on the i, the letter stems, and in the interface a control's corner is ¼ of its height.
- **Every gap is 3 m**: the offset, the gap between mark and word, and the clear space.
- **Every height in the lockup is a mark measure.**

## Small sizes

![Pixel-fitted cuts for 16 and 20 pixels and the master from 24 pixels](data:image/png;base64,)

| Cut | Side · offset · edge · radius (px) | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 16 px | 11 · 4 · 2 · 3 | Favicons, browser tabs, the Built on Whity badge |
| 20 px | 14 · 5 · 2 · 3.5 | Touch navigation, small app chrome |
| Master | 8 m · 3 m · 1 m · 2 m (m = 2px at 24px) | 24px and up, all print |

`Mark` and `Lockup` choose the cut from the size. In files: `whity-mark-16-*.svg`, `whity-mark-20-*.svg` and `whity-mark-*.svg`.

## The lockup

![The horizontal lockup with its cap line, baseline and 3-module gap, and the stacked lockup](data:image/png;base64,)

- The word's cap height is the plane's side (8 m) and its x-height 6 m. The cap line is the platform's top edge and the baseline its bottom edge.
- The word starts 3 m after the sheet's right edge.
- The wordmark is Readex Pro 600, tracked −1%, outlined. The dot on the i is a rounded square as wide as the stem with corners ¼ of its side; outside corners of the letters are rounded to ¼ of the stem; inside corners stay sharp. It exists only as outlines: never set "Whity" in live type next to the mark.
- **Horizontal** is the default. **Stacked** (mark centred 3 m above the word) is for square spaces. **The mark alone** once the name is already on screen.
- The lockup is the same in every language. In Arabic layouts it stays left to right, with the mark on the left.

## Clear space and minimum size

![Clear space of 3 modules around the live area, and the minimum sizes](data:image/png;base64,)

- Keep **3 m** clear around the live area.
- Minimum sizes: the horizontal lockup 20px tall on screen (word cap height 13.3px) and 6 mm in print; the stacked lockup 48px tall; the mark alone 16px.

## Colourways

![The five colourways on their grounds](data:image/png;base64,)

| File suffix | Platform and edge | Window | Word | Ground |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `colour` | Whity Blue `#0961bb` | white | Ink `#0a0a0a` | White, the grey page, light photos |
| `reversed` | `#59a0f9` | white | `#f2f3f5` | Dark grounds, dark photos |
| `onbrand` | white | Whity Blue | white | Whity Blue only: the app icon, the blueprint |
| `ink` | one colour, window knocked out | | ink | One-colour print, stamps, embossing |
| `white` | one colour, window knocked out | | white | One colour on dark: etching, signage |

Exactly five. Each file has fixed colours (an `<img>` can't follow the theme): pick the file for the ground. In code, `Mark` and `Lockup` with `tone="auto"` follow the theme.

## App icon and favicons

![The app icon, the rounded preview and the favicons at 32, 20 and 16 pixels](data:image/png;base64,)

- **App icon**: a Whity Blue tile of 18 m with the `onbrand` mark whose live area is 61% of the tile (3.5 m margin). The same tile is the PWA icon, the social avatar and large favicons. Ship the square (`app-icon-1024.png`); platforms apply their own corner mask. Never add rounding, a border or a shadow.
- **Favicon**: `favicon.svg` uses the 16px cut and switches to the dark colours in a dark browser theme; `favicon.ico` carries 16, 32 and 48px.

## Don't

![Eight misuses of the mark](data:image/png;base64,)

- Don't rotate, stretch, mirror or recolour the mark, or change the offset. The mark never mirrors, even in Arabic.
- Don't put the colour version on Whity Blue (use `onbrand`) or on a busy photo without a sheet behind it.
- No gradients, glows, shadows or outlines.
- Don't redraw the wordmark, set it in another font or in lowercase, or translate the name.

Files: the Logos asset group (SVG and the 1024px app icon) and `handoff/logos/` (every colourway and cut, PNG exports, `favicon.svg`, `favicon.ico`, the Built on Whity badges).
